question: Can PSAU's records clarify the citation year and public access path for Marjorie C. Gonzales's Pasac River undergraduate thesis, and can its findings be used without the thesis itself?

source.titleAsListed: Ichthyofaunal Diversity and Distribution in Pasac River, Sasmuan, Pampanga
source.sourceType: Undergraduate thesis as identified by PSAU's archived student-research table and cited by later literature

citationYearComparison.PSAUStudentResearchRecord: PSAU Quality Assurance archive lists Marjorie C. Gonzales, the matching Pasac River thesis title, adviser Dante M. Mendoza, and year 2017.
citationYearComparison.BaysaEtAl2019Citation: The 2019 Minalin Channel–Pampanga River Basin article cites Gonzales M.C. 2017 and labels the work an unpublished B.S. thesis at PSAU.
citationYearComparison.MendozaPSAUJournalBibliography: The PSAU Research Journal full-text copy by Dante M. Mendoza cites a matching thesis title as Gonzales M. 2016.
citationYearComparison.assessment: Two records support 2017 as the student-research year and as the citation year used in the 2019 paper; one bibliography gives 2016. Without the thesis title page, library catalog record, or author confirmation, the discrepancy is documented rather than silently corrected. The 2017 student-research table is not proof of the manuscript's exact completion, deposit, or defense date.

boundedSearches: Exact thesis title and author web searches
PSAU domain search for the exact title, author, and PDF format
PSAU Library, OPAC, and repository search terms
located: A PSAU Quality Assurance archive student-research listing with title, author, adviser, and year
Secondary citations in a 2019 fish-diversity article and the Mendoza PSAU Research Journal bibliography
A PSAU Quality Assurance archive copy of the PSAU library manual describing historical thesis-section rules
notLocated: The original thesis PDF or scan
A public item-level library catalog record, call number, or repository entry for this thesis
A thesis abstract or primary species tables attributable to this thesis
accessSearch.searchLimit: These bounded searches did not locate the thesis itself; that is not evidence that no copy, catalog record, or other access route exists.

libraryAccessContext.archiveDate: The QA archive containing the reproduced library manual is published as a 2022 PSAU Quality Assurance Office flipbook.
libraryAccessContext.historicalRuleAsArchived: The reproduced manual says other users may use the library subject to its rules and regulations; its thesis section says theses and dissertations are for library use only and may not be photocopied.
libraryAccessContext.currentApplicability: This is an archived policy copy, not confirmation of current library hours, access eligibility, photocopying rules, or remote-service availability. Verify current rules before visiting or requesting reproduction.

researchUseLimits: The 2019 Minalin article is a secondary citation to Gonzales (2017), not a primary copy or an independent reanalysis of the thesis dataset.
The Mendoza PSAU article also cites the thesis but does not reproduce or validate the thesis's species inventory in the passages reviewed.

Do not infer a Pasac species list, abundance, river-wide distribution, date-specific occurrence, waterbody geometry, diet, catchability, or current status from these bibliographic records or from secondary summaries.
The Pasac/Pasak waterbody spelling crosswalk remains unresolved in the related Mendoza source reviews.
nextAction: If primary thesis data are still needed, search the current PSAU library catalog by exact title and author and ask library staff only for the catalog locator, abstract availability, current external-reader rules, and whether supervised reading is possible. Do not request copying or redistribution until the applicable permission is clear. Otherwise keep the thesis as a bibliographic lead and continue with independently accessible, attributable sources.

sources.supports: PSAU Quality Assurance Office archive, student-research table: matching Pasac River thesis title, Marjorie C. Gonzales, adviser Dante M. Mendoza, and year 2017. This is an institutional bibliographic/project record, not the thesis manuscript.
Baysa et al. (2019) article and references: cites Gonzales M.C. 2017 as an unpublished PSAU B.S. thesis and refers to the thesis in its discussion; secondary evidence only.

PSAU Research Journal article bibliography, printed p. 32 in the reproduced issue: cites a matching Pasac River thesis as Gonzales M. 2016, establishing the conflicting citation year but not the thesis's actual completion date.

PSAU Quality Assurance Office archive of a library manual: describes the library as available to other users subject to rules, but is an archived policy reference and does not establish current access terms.
PSAU Quality Assurance Office archive of a library manual: its thesis section says theses were library-use-only and not photocopiable; treat as historical policy pending current confirmation.
